xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5171: Issue drawer header shows 'Issue details' instead of the title until the full issue list loads (or forever if the list lacks it)

plan.title: Issue drawer header shows 'Issue details' instead of the title until the full issue list loads (or forever if the list lacks it)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The drawer header reads issue?.title ?? 'Issue details' and finds the issue only in the global issuesRaw list. The list takes 2.6 s to 4 s to arrive, lacks new issues until the next push, and never holds backlog or canceled issues (the snapshot uses getIssues() with the default 'current' cycle filter). The cockpit header shows the bare identifier and the phone sheet shows 'Loading issue…' or 'This issue is not in the pipeline.' for the same reason.
narratives.Proposal: Add GET /api/issues/:id (new routes/issue-read.ts) that looks the issue up in getIssues({ cycle: 'all', includeCompleted: true }), backfills through the tracker door when absent, and answers 404 only on IssueNotFoundError (503 otherwise). Teach issue-title-fallback.ts to memoize the failure kind. Add one frontend hook, useIssueRecord, that prefers the list entry and otherwise runs a React Query fetch of the route, and one renderer, IssueHeaderTitle, that shows the title, a neutral skeleton while loading, or the identifier with a hint on failure. Use them in the drawer, cockpit and phone sheet headers. Register the route at read:state with an explicit admin row for resource-allocated, add a no-loss row, a committed Playwright check, and docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing the Linear adapter's mapping of every LinearApiError to IssueNotFoundError.
- Changing the snapshot's cycle filter so backlog and canceled issues reach issuesRaw.
- Live-updating or polling the per-issue cache; a list row replaces it when it appears.
- Rate-limiting GET /api/issues/:id beyond the existing tracker-door memo.
- Threading new props through CommandDeck/index.tsx or changing cockpit tab labels.
- Removing the PAN-3659 backfill trigger in subscribeIssueEvents.
- Reworking the phone sheet beyond its loading and not-found branches.
- Any header surface rendering the literal string 'Issue details'.
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap.

metadata.sizeJustification: Nine small vertical items across one server route, one tracker-door change, one shared hook, one renderer and three header surfaces; the surfaces share the hook so they belong to one plan.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the route in a new module src/dashboard/server/routes/issue-read.ts built only from public IssueDataService methods.
autoDecisions.rationale: routes/issues.ts is 889 lines and issue-data-service.ts sits 6 lines under its file-size cap; routes/test-removal-waiver.ts is the existing pattern for a separate issue route module.

autoDecisions.summary: Look the issue up with getIssues({ cycle: 'all', includeCompleted: true }).
autoDecisions.rationale: The snapshot's default 'current' cycle drops backlog and canceled rows, and backfillIssue is a no-op for them, so only the 'all' view finds them.

autoDecisions.summary: Answer 503 for every tracker failure that is not IssueNotFoundError, including an unconfigured tracker.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires 404 only when the tracker says the issue does not exist; 503 tells the client the read could not be completed.

autoDecisions.summary: Accept Linear's mapping of every LinearApiError to IssueNotFoundError.
autoDecisions.rationale: Other callers depend on the adapter; the header shows the identifier plus a hint either way, so only the hint text differs.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope GET /api/issues/:id at read:state and add an explicit admin row for GET /api/issues/resource-allocated before it.
autoDecisions.rationale: GET /api/issues is already read:state; route-scope matching is first-match, so without the explicit row the :id pattern would silently widen resource-allocated from admin.

autoDecisions.summary: Use retry: false and staleTime 30 s for the per-issue query, with no refetchInterval, and return 404 as data.
autoDecisions.rationale: The server memoizes tracker failures for 10 minutes, so a client retry gets the same answer; a query-level retry would also override test clients' retry:false and add a real 1 s delay to failure tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Apply the new rule to the phone sheet by replacing its 'Loading issue…' and 'not in the pipeline' branches.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the mobile sheet among the header surfaces; the per-issue read gives it the full row when the list lacks it.

autoDecisions.summary: Ship the Playwright check as a new case in tests/e2e/styleguide-conformance.spec.ts and leave the signed-in live check to the test role's UAT.
autoDecisions.rationale: That spec already serves the real frontend with mocked fetch and opens ?issue=PAN-1148 in CI; a committed signed-in check against a live dashboard is not reproducible in CI.

autoDecisions.summary: Rewrite docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md line 7 to name the one per-issue read as an allowed exception.
autoDecisions.rationale: The doc currently forbids the issue view from adding another endpoint, which this fix deliberately does.

items.title: Memoize the tracker-door failure kind (not-found vs unavailable)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In issue-title-fallback.ts, replace failedLookupsAt with failedLookups: Map<string, { at, kind: 'not-found' | 'unavailable' }>. lookupIssue returns { kind: 'found', issue } | { kind: 'not-found' } | { kind: 'unavailable' }: Effect.catchTag('IssueNotFoundError') maps to not-found, every other failure (timeout, API, auth, factory throw, no tracker) maps to unavailable. resolveMissingIssue keeps its Promise<Issue | null> signature and records the kind on failure. resolveMissingIssueTitles reads failedLookups.get(id)?.at. Export missingIssueFailureKind(issueId) returning the fresh memoized kind or null. Add the five tests from the PRD.

items.title: Given a tracker that fails getIssue with IssueNotFoundError, When resolveMissingIssue runs, Then it returns null and missingIssueFailureKind returns 'not-found'
Given a tracker that fails with any other error, or a prefix with no tracker, When resolveMissingIssue runs, Then missingIssueFailureKind returns 'unavailable'
Given a successful lookup, missingIssueFailureKind returns null; given a failure older than FAILURE_RETRY_MS (fake time), it returns null
Given the change, resolveMissingIssue still returns Promise<Issue | null>, resolveMissingIssueTitles keeps its signature, and every pre-existing case in issue-title-fallback.test.ts passes

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/dashboard/server/routes/issue-read.ts exporting issueReadRouteLayer and readIssueRow (code in PRD). Register the layer in server.ts next to testRemovalWaiverRouteLayer. In route-scopes.ts, right after the GET /api/issues row, add GET /api/issues/resource-allocated at admin and then GET /api/issues/:id at read:state, each with a PAN-5171 comment. Add the no-loss-matrix row. Write the route tests listed in the PRD, including the static-route precedence test, plus the route-scope and phone-surface assertions. Add "/api/issues/:id" and "/api/issues/resource-allocated" right after "/api/issues" in TELEMETRY_CLIENT_ROUTES (packages/contracts/src/telemetry.ts line 188) and in the client_route row of docs/TELEMETRY.md (line 190): route-scopes.test.ts requires every ROUTE_SCOPES path there and telemetry-docs.test.ts checks the doc.
